shape_hint: Solid rivet: a plain cylindrical shank of diameter d1 and length l (chosen by user) with a head formed on one end. DIN 660 head is a low round (button/snap) head of diameter dk ~ 1.75 d1 and height k ~ 0.6 d1 with a rounded dome of radius r; DIN 661 head is a 90 degree countersunk (flat conical) head of diameter dk and height k ~ 0.5 d1. The other end is plain and gets upset after setting.

role_map.dk: head diameter nominal (same for DIN 660 and 661)
role_map.k_round: head height of the round (snap/button) head DIN 660
role_map.k_csk: head height of the countersunk head DIN 661 (approx.)

notes: Cold-formed solid rivets, shank diameters 2-8 mm. DIN 660 and DIN 661 share the dk column; heads differ in k. Shank length l is a free choice (standard lists l=2..40+; mass tables exist but are not part of this table). ISO 1051 (cold-formed rivets, d 1-8 style) and KS B 1101 are not separately verified; values equal DIN 660/661 as far as these sources show. Rows 1-1.6, 3.5, 7, 10 exist in the standards but are not published for lack of a third source.

verification.checks_done: Re-downloaded all 6 URLs live (HTTP 200) and parsed the HTML tables. Matrix: 7 rows (2,2.5,3,4,5,6,8) x 3 value columns (dk, k_round, k_csk) x 3 clusters (fasten.it both editions, boltsfastener, theo-schrauben; German decimal commas converted) = 63/63 cells numerically equal to the record; dk compared in both the 660 and the 661 tables (identical in every source). Headers: dk = 'dk nom'/'d2'/'d2'; k_round = 'k js14'/'k'/'k'; k_csk = 'k ~'/'k'/'k' (all read from headers). Physical: dk/d1 = 1.73-1.76 on every row, k_round = 0.6 d1 exactly, k_csk grows 1.0..4.0 with d1 and k_csk < k_round < dk/2, dk/k monotonic.
problems: Every cell sits at exactly 3 clusters (no margin); if any of fasten.it / boltsfastener / theo-schrauben is later judged a copy of another, the whole table falls below T2.
theo-schrauben.de belongs to the 'German shop dataset' family of clusters; only that one member is used, so it counts once (correct).

Row label is the bare number ('2','2.5',...); column d1 duplicates it. dk is shared by DIN 660 and 661 (identical in all sources). k_csk is 'k approx.' (DIN 661), k_round is nominal 'k js14' (DIN 660).
Covers cold-formed rivets d 2-8 only; rows 7 and 10 (2 sources) and 1-1.6, 3.5 (1 source) correctly dropped; ISO 1051 / KS / ASME not covered.

standard_full: DIN 660 (round head) / DIN 661 (countersunk 90 deg), shank d1 2-8 mm
